pageDescription: FMS uses Font Awesome 6 Pro for UI icons (Solid, Regular, and Light). The design system handbook documents principles and usage at Foundations → Icons → Overview (/foundation/icons/overview).

rows: Font Awesome 6 Pro via the shared Font Awesome Kit npm package
Emojis, random SVGs, or other icon libraries unless design specifies otherwise
Match Figma: style (solid / regular / light) and icon name
Guess icon names or swap styles without checking design
Monochrome icons using text/icon colour tokens

steps.label: Step 1:
steps.body: Find the icon frame component in the assets and drag the result to the workspace.
steps.imageAlt: Figma assets panel showing the icon frame component

steps.label: Step 2:
steps.bodyBeforeLink: Visit Font Awesome web page and search for the Icon that you want to use.
steps.imageAlt: Font Awesome website search for an icon

steps.label: Step 3:
steps.body: You can copy it by clicking on the Icon Name on the popup / Copy Glyph
steps.imageAlt: Font Awesome icon detail showing copy glyph

steps.label: Step 4:
steps.body: Go back to Figma canvas and paste the icon name. All done!
steps.imageAlt: Figma icon frame properties with icon name pasted
